rulesClauses: This champion can't level up. (6): Draw a card and put a level counter on Nameless Champion. Activate this ability only once.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The ability's printed cost is (6) with no [REST], but DoActivatedAbility() applied the implicit REST to every static champion ability, so Nameless Champion rested when activated (live repro on HEAD: Status 1). The once-only check lives in $activateAbilityPrereqs, which the direct activation path never consults; it only appeared to work because the rested champion could not activate again that turn. Once the champion stays awake the second activation was possible every turn. Fix: Nameless Champion skips the implicit REST and DoActivatedAbility() refuses a second activation before any cost is paid.
